text:
Looking at this transaction data, I need to:
1. Identify transactions dated 2024-03-18 to 2024-05-08 inclusive
2. Filter for "paid" status (which includes 'paid', 'PAID', and 'settled')
3. Convert EUR to USD at 1 EUR = 1.145 USD
4. Calculate the average

Let me create a script to process this carefully:

```python
from datetime import datetime

transactions = """T1000 | Mar 02 2024 | North | Delta | $3,670.87 | settled
T1001 | 2024-03-23 | East | Garnet | 854,01 EUR | pending
T1002 | Mar 19 2024 | West | Garnet | 3.688,89 EUR | chargeback
T1003 | 14/04/2024 | South | Acme | $4,649.76 | PAID
T1010 | 07/05/2024 | West | Ember | $3,371.10 | paid
T1016 | 2024-03-20 | West | Delta | $2,062.80 | chargeback
T1018 | 2024-04-16 | East | Fjord | $3,737.75 | settled
T1022 | 06/04/2024 | South | Cobalt | $1,046.70 | REFUND
T1023 | Apr 04 2024 | West | Cobalt | $2,518.79 | PAID
T1027 | 2024-04-13 | South | Ember | 3.034,64 EUR | pending
T1030 | 2024-04-24 | East | Delta | $3,018.38 | on hold
T1032 | 2024-05-03 | South | Fjord | $2,986.65 | chargeback
T1033 | 31/03/2024 | West | Garnet | $4,700.14 | settled
T1034 | Mar 27 2024 | East | Birch | $770.53 | PAID
T1037 | 12/04/2024 | South | Fjord | 3.877,58 EUR | paid
T1039 | 2024-03-23 | West | Acme | $973.29 | pending
T1041 | 23/04/2024 | North | Garnet | $1,390.52 | PAID
T1044 | 2024-05-01 | East | Fjord | $3,896.21 | refunded
T1047 | 2024-04-08 | East | Ember | $968.75 | settled
T1048 | 2024-04-04 | West | Cobalt | $4,193.76 | PAID
T1049 | Apr 21 2024 | South | Acme | $1,560.66 | PAID
T1050 | 01/04/2024 | North | Delta | $42.13 | paid
T1060 | 26/04/2024 | North | Delta | $4,461.44 | chargeback
T1061 | 27/04/2024 | West | Garnet | $4,246.81 | paid
T1018 | 2024-04-16 | East | Fjord | $3,327.20 | settled
T1023 | 2024-04-04 | West | Cobalt | $2,518.79 | refunded"""

paid_statuses = {'paid', 'PAID', 'settled'}
start_date = datetime(2024, 3, 18)
end_date = datetime(2024, 5, 8)
eur_to_usd = 1.145

# Track latest version of each transaction ID
latest = {}
for line in transactions.strip().split('\n'):
    parts = [p.strip() for p in line.split('|')]
    tid = parts[0]
    latest[tid] = parts

qualifying = []
for tid, parts in latest.items():
    date_str = parts[1]
    status = parts[5]
    amount_str = parts[4]
    
    # Parse date
    for fmt in ['%b %d %Y', '%Y-%m-%d', '%d/%m/%Y']:
        try:
            date = datetime.strptime(date_str, fmt)
            break
        except:
            pass
    else:
        continue
    
    # Check date range and status
    if start_date <= date <= end_date and status in paid_statuses:
        # Parse amount
        if 'EUR' in amount_str:
            amount = float(amount_str.replace('EUR', '').replace('.', '').replace(',', '.').strip())
            amount_usd = amount * eur_to_usd
        else:
            amount_usd = float(amount_str.replace('$', '').replace(',', '').strip())
        
        qualifying.append((tid, date, amount_usd))

# Calculate average
total = sum(amt for _, _, amt in qualifying)
average = total / len(qualifying)

print(f"Qualifying transactions: {len(qualifying)}")
for tid, date, amt in sorted(qualifying, key=lambda x: x[1]):
    print(f"  {tid} | {date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')} | ${amt:.2f}")
print(f"\nTotal: ${total:.2f}")
print(f"Average: ${average:.2f}")
```
